mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact determinant and independent negative quadratic direction in a background-subtracted pressureless two-species longitudinal Newtonian Poisson/Gauss surrogate, with four exact rational examples
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Symbolic rational expressions and positive square roots over Q; exact SymPy arithmetic
mathematics.conventions: g0=4 pi G; h_a=rho_a=m_a n_a; y_a=sqrt(rho_a) xi_a; H_ab=sqrt(rho_a rho_b)(zeta_a zeta_b/p-g0); rho_a,g0,p>0; frozen k parallel E; background forces subtracted or externally supported by declaration

bounds.success_means: Symbolic residuals vanish and each declared example determinant is strictly negative
bounds.failure_means: Identity or example implementation requires diagnosis; timeout/output limit is inconclusive

non_claims: An exactly homogeneous charged co-moving mixture with constant E is not a solved RTM background; subtraction/support is a toy assumption.
No instability theorem for an actual RTM/portal halo, branch closure, remnant fate or rejection of the separate one-current RTM construction follows.
No pressure, background gradients, response of external support, full metric constraints, conversion, interface or cosmological evolution is included.
